afterReconnect.note: A failed dynamic import stays failed for the life of the page, so the cold format only exports again after the page reloads. No service worker or app-shell cache exists, which is why the plan scopes offline to already-loaded work.

knownLimitations: A route chunk or export builder that was never loaded cannot be fetched while the network is disabled; the app-shell/offline-bootstrap case is explicitly out of scope for this release.
This is a browser with the network disabled, not a browser reading a cached build from an installed service worker — none is implemented.
